details: The only download is one 308 GB tar.gz (fb-ctrl-oss S3, 1,135 HDF5 session files with 16-channel sEMG); the keylogger labels cannot be fetched separately. Also: the repo LICENSE file is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (README says CC-BY-NC-4.0); the paper is NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks, not just arXiv.
